Each tool is named only in its own hub (scan: submit_critical_bin_request only in converted_bin_customer_fill_request_0c1a9c30; record_customer_owned_conversion only in customer_owned_conversion_entry_63a66bf9; book_converted_bin_fill only in credit_hold_first_fill_booking_55bac8ae).

### Producible, as seeded
- **Credit.**
  - Net 60 due dates are +60 on every invoice.
  - Monthly consumption invoices are dated month-end and match the vmi consumption lines. Per-visit replenishment invoices match the visit totals.
  - Every invoice before the frozen date was paid before its due date, so no finance charge arises.
  - The hold is `on_hold` / `over_limit`: the running balance first exceeds 440000.00 (10% tolerance on 400000.00) on 2026-09-25 and stands at 448680.00. The limit 400000.00 is inside the Net 60 band.
  - The invoices posted during the hold are critical VMI replenishment (allowed by the vmi charter) and month-end consumption.
- **Pricing.**
  - CPA-44120 was proposed 2024-12-02 and became effective 2025-01-06 (inside the 60-day validity). Its expiry 2028-01-05 matches the 36-month term.
  - 108 lines, inside 100–2500. All are effective 2025-01-06, each 21 days after its quote, inside the 90-day validity.
  - 2026-Q3 qualifying spend is about 509.9k, below the 750000.00 first bracket, so the missing rebate is correct.
- **Order.**
  - 41827 lines are at the 142.50 contract price.
  - SO-4440918 was booked 09-23, before the hold, and backordered 09-24, inside the 1-business-day notice. Freight is free (Priority, 100.00 threshold). The NDA bookings are within the 2 included expedites a month.
  - The ship-to is Priority, so 0 route deliveries.

- **S5 (order × credit).**

  - The NDA bookings SO-4431187 (2026-03-02) and SO-4437426 (2026-06-15) never ship, backorder or invoice.
  - No scored effect. The rush cover reads bookings and the supply/backorder factors read BO-440918, which stand. The limit share and hold reason sit far inside their bands (ratio 1.12).
- **S1** (carried note).
